Who recommended that meal plan to you?
A. My nutrition consultant.
B. At my favorite restaurant.
C. Mainly fruits and vegetables.
context.transcript_translation:
谁向你推荐了这个膳食计划？
A. 我的营养顾问。
B. 在我最喜欢的餐厅。
C. 主要吃水果和蔬菜。

items.question: Who recommended that meal plan to you?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Who recommended that meal plan to you?”，自然应答是“My nutrition consultant.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（My nutrition consultant.）。
